company_name: Lam Research Corporation (LRCX / 科林研發)

categories: Memory (3D NAND High-Aspect-Ratio HAR Etch / ALD & Advanced HBM/DRAM)
Foundry (Advanced Logic Gate-All-Around GAA, Nanosheet & Interconnect Etch/Clean)
Logic / Specialty / Packaging (Power Semi, Advanced Packaging & CSBG Recurring Services)

the_pivot.en: Lam Research (NASDAQ: LRCX) commands the global high-aspect-ratio (HAR) dry etching and atomic layer deposition (ALD) technological duopoly alongside Tokyo Electron and Applied Materials. Critical to both 3D NAND vertical scaling (>200 to 400+ layers), High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e/HBM4 via TSV etch), and sub-2nm GAA nanosheet selective etching (Sense.i / Coronus platforms), Lam reached an operating inflection point where gross margins rebounded from 44.6% in 2023 to 48.7% in 2025 and 50.0% in 2026, delivering over $7.3B in operating income.
the_pivot.zh: 科林研發（Lam Research / LRCX）為全球半導體高深寬比（HAR）電漿蝕刻與原子層沉積（ALD）設備絕對龍頭。作為 3D NAND 垂直堆疊（200 層跨越至 400+ 層）、高頻寬記憶體（HBM3e/HBM4 晶圓級 TSV 矽穿孔）與次 2 奈米 GAA 環繞閘極奈米片選擇性蝕刻（Sense.i / Coronus 平台）不可或缺的關鍵製程基石，Lam 在 2024 年記憶體週期觸底後迎來強烈拐點，毛利率自 2023 年 44.6% 強勁修復至 2025 年 48.7% 與 2026 年 50.0%，營業利益一舉突破 73 億美元。

productivity.en: Human capital efficiency remains best-in-class within the wafer fab equipment (WFE) tier, delivering $970k to $1.06M USD in Revenue per FTE and over $472k to $532k USD in Gross Profit per FTE across 19,000 to 20,200 elite process and field engineers.
productivity.zh: 在半導體晶圓前端製造設備（WFE）領域，Lam 展現極高的人力資本效率，全球約 1.9 萬至 2.0 萬名製程與研發工程團隊創造每人 97 萬至 106 萬美元營收（約 NT$ 3,100 萬～3,400 萬元/人），人均毛利突破 47 萬～53 萬美元。

value_vs_volume.en: High-margin Customer Support Business Group (CSBG) recurring spares, upgrades, and Reliant secondary systems generate over 35% of total revenue, acting as a resilient cash cushion during cyclical down-turns and amplifying gross margin during memory up-cycles.
value_vs_volume.zh: 高毛利率之客戶服務事業群（CSBG / 耗材零組件、腔體升級與 Reliant 翻新設備）貢獻超過 35% 的經常性收入，在晶圓廠資本支出下行週期提供充沛的現金緩衝，並於記憶體上行擴產週期劇烈放大營運槓桿。

lean_maturity.rating: Level 5 (Sub-Atomic Precision Etch & AI Digital Twin Chamber Telemetry)
lean_maturity.description: Sense.i plasma etch architecture with autonomous chamber matching, real-time predictive algorithm yield telemetry, and cleanroom atomic-scale selective removal.

ladder.name: Legacy Standalone Dry Etch Systems
ladder.desc: Manual batch recipe tuning and standard capacitive plasma tools.

ladder.name: Integrated Cluster Tool Modular Platforms
ladder.desc: Multi-station chemical vapor deposition (Vector) and high-density inductively coupled plasma (ICP) etch.

ladder.name: High-Aspect-Ratio 3D NAND & Cryogenic Etching
ladder.desc: Sub-zero cryo-etching, atomic layer etching (ALE), and wafer bevel cleaning (Coronus).

ladder.name: Sense.i AI-Connected Smart Chamber Fleet
ladder.desc: Fleet-wide autonomous self-tuning sensor telemetry, 50% chamber footprint reduction, and AI predictive maintenance.

ladder.name: Autonomous Atomic Material Synthesis & GAA Co-Optimization
ladder.desc: Cognitive sub-angstrom selective molecular removal, 3D monolithic CFET etch co-design, and real-time fab-wide closed-loop yield optimization.
